directAnswer.label: What do rtylr plans include?
directAnswer.body: Every rtylr plan includes all seven apps: POS, ERP, CRM, HR, Finance, Flow and the hardware integrations. Plans differ by scale rather than by feature, so what changes is how many people and locations you run and the controls a larger team needs. Free covers 10 people at one location and needs no card. rtylr has not published prices for Pro and Scale yet, so those are quoted.

faqItems.question: How much does rtylr cost?
faqItems.answer: rtylr has not published its prices yet. The Free plan is genuinely free and needs no card, so you can run a location on it today. For Pro or Scale, contact us and we will talk through your team size and locations. We would rather quote you honestly than put a number here we might change.

faqItems.question: Can I switch plans at any time?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Upgrade and the new features unlock instantly. Downgrade and the change applies at the end of the current period. Your data, team, and settings stay put.

faqItems.question: Is there a free trial for Pro?
faqItems.answer: Every new workspace starts with a 14-day Pro trial, and it needs no card. At day 14 it reverts to the Free plan automatically unless you tell us otherwise.

faqItems.question: What happens when I hit 10 seats on Free?
faqItems.answer: You're prompted to move to Pro before adding seat 11. Nothing breaks. Your data, reports, and configurations all carry over.

faqItems.question: When does Scale apply?
faqItems.answer: Scale is built for teams past 30 active seats. It removes the seat and location limits and adds SSO, audit logs, a dedicated success manager and an SLA.

faqItems.question: Any contract or lock-in?
faqItems.answer: None. You can cancel at any time, and your data is exportable while the account is open.
